title: 3.4 Yes and No
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Ask yes/no questions with the verb first (Isst er? Liest du?) and answer Ja, ... / Nein, ... nicht.
grammar_function: Verb + subject? Ja, subject + verb. Nein, subject + verb + nicht.
